title: Provision complete release CI runtime
summary: Provision complete CI runtimes and make source/package verification deterministic and scope-aware.
reason: The active CI jobs lacked runtime prerequisites; broad tests exposed host-timezone and checkout-line-ending dependence; and package tests incorrectly applied full-source generated-report and Node-dev-dependency assertions to the reduced release layout.
behavior_before: CI release/package jobs failed on missing runtime prerequisites; metrics timestamps changed with the host timezone; CRLF checkouts left worksheet fields blank; and source-only assertions failed against intentionally omitted package content.
behavior_after: CI provisions and validates the complete runtime without weakening gates; timestamps and worksheet generation are host-stable; source-checkout assertions are explicitly separated from package-applicable generator tests; pinned downloads remain SHA-256 verified; package exclusion policy is unchanged.
manual_validation: CI-style bundled-Python discovery passed 3,131 tests with 1 expected skip after regenerating the duplicate-test report
Deployable lean package build and copied-folder plus extracted-ZIP acceptance passed with immutable package roots and zero leftover child processes
Full source release self-test passed every required Python, generated-context, dependency, lint, WebView, PowerShell, tool-integration, and end-to-end gate
Fresh test-inclusive package build and package-mode verification passed after explicit source/package test classification
Initialize-CiMediaTools.ps1 -InstallMissing passed against an empty temporary repository root
Final test-inclusive package ZIP SHA-256 C5FA42F061DDAE33BC7B65A22456AD0A13E03F72E26BFCA30E0F106BE5D09770 (616,710,472 bytes)
Tauri CheckOnly, cargo check --locked, cargo test --locked (43 passed), and cargo build --release --locked passed
rollback_plan: Revert the workflow, CI media-provisioner, metrics formatting, and worksheet regex changes; no packaged runtime, local operator config, or media state requires migration.
notes:
Release gates remain strict. Live config, runtime state, credentials, source-control data, and optional FFplay/MKVToolNix GUI bulk exclusions were not changed. Job-level runner.temp expressions were replaced with runner-time GITHUB_ENV exports because the runner context is not available while GitHub constructs a job. Pinned downloads retry bounded transient transport failures, but every attempt must still pass the exact SHA-256 gate.
Preserve pipeline timestamp offsets so metrics output is independent of the CI host timezone.
Cover timestamp offset and completion-date stability across host timezones.
Make worksheet identity-row replacement work with CRLF and LF checkouts.
Guard the worksheet CRLF-safe replacement expression.
Regenerated canonical release-test evidence after the CI portability fixes.
Classify full-source duplicate-report freshness as source-checkout-only while retaining package-applicable generator tests.
Refresh the canonical summary for the package-scope classification.
Skip Node-backed generated-output execution only when package policy omits WebView dev dependencies, with a guard regression.
Refresh the package-aware WebView tooling test summary.
